headline: OpenAI launches Codex Labs to scale Codex enterprise deployments with major partners.

items.title: Scaling Codex to enterprises worldwide
items.summary: OpenAI has launched Codex Labs in partnership with Accenture, PwC, Infosys, and others to facilitate the deployment and scaling of Codex across various stages of the software development lifecycle. This initiative aims to enhance automation and efficiency in enterprise software development, reaching 4 million Codex weekly active users. The partnership is expected to streamline the integration of AI in coding processes, reducing time and cost significantly.
items.why_it_matters: This development significantly impacts software development by integrating AI tools more deeply into enterprise environments, potentially revolutionizing coding practices.

items.title: ChatGPT Images 2.0
items.summary: OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.0, marking a significant improvement over its predecessor. The model enhances the ability to generate high-quality images from text prompts, providing more accurate and detailed outputs. This update is set to improve applications in creative industries and content generation, offering a more robust tool for designers and developers.

items.title: Accelerate Generative AI Inference on Amazon SageMaker AI with G7e Instances
items.summary: Amazon has announced the availability of G7e instances on SageMaker AI, utilizing NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs. These instances support up to 8 GPUs, each with 96 GB of GDDR7 memory, offering enhanced performance for generative AI inference tasks. This launch aims to reduce inference latency and increase throughput, making it an attractive option for AI developers focused on large-scale deployments.

items.title: ToolSimulator: scalable tool testing for AI agents
items.summary: AWS introduces ToolSimulator, a new framework for testing AI agents at scale. This tool allows developers to simulate interactions with external APIs, avoiding the risks associated with live testing such as exposure of PII. By providing a controlled environment, ToolSimulator helps ensure the security and reliability of AI agents before deployment.

items.title: Claude Code to be removed from Anthropic's Pro plan?
items.summary: Anthropic is reportedly considering the removal of Claude Code from its Pro plan, though official confirmation is pending. This move could impact users relying on Claude Code's capabilities, prompting them to seek alternative solutions or upgrade their plans.

items.title: Gradient-based Planning for World Models at Longer Horizons
items.summary: The Berkeley AI Research team has introduced a new approach called GRASP, focusing on gradient-based planning for improving world models over extended time horizons. This methodology could enhance predictive capabilities and decision-making processes in AI systems by effectively extending the planning horizon.
items.source: The Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research Blog

items.title: Meta to start capturing employee mouse movements, keystrokes for AI training
items.summary: Meta plans to begin capturing employee mouse movements and keystrokes as part of its data collection for AI training. This move raises concerns over privacy and ethical data use, sparking debates within the tech community about the boundaries of surveillance in workplaces.
